name: Kiso (Japan, village)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kiso village emblem in orange: a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kiso, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kiso village emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised character
